title: Interaction: Cinderheart × charge / release
answer: Cinderheart × charge / release: One hovering heart per original caster advances through three paid tiers, or four with Ancient Mastery; charges extend but never exceed a 360-tick creation window. Crouch-use deliberately launches along the owner's live aim without transferring attribution. Signature: Nested coal-red, ember, gold, and white flame seals with rising heartbeat pitch, then a directional release ribbon.
